sources.name: American Community Survey 2024 1-Year Estimates, US Census Bureau (via Census Reporter)
sources.note: Only California, Texas, Florida, New York, Pennsylvania, Illinois, Ohio, Georgia, North Carolina, Michigan, New Jersey, Virginia, Washington and Arizona have datasets, so these weights are the fourteen states' shares of their combined population, not of the United States. A persona generated for the United States is therefore representative of those fourteen states only.
